profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: I’m a detail‑oriented and collaborative software engineer who takes pride in building thoughtful, reliable solutions. I approach complex problems with patience, curiosity, and a strong sense of ownership. Whether I’m designing global UI systems, refining form architectures, or partnering with backend teams to deliver seamless workflows. I care deeply about clarity, consistency, and creating experiences that genuinely help users. As a teammate, I’m supportive, communicative, and always willing to dive in, learn, and contribute wherever I’m needed.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Round Rock, Texas, United States · Remote
positions.description: At Dell, I worked on a global Lit Element Web Component functionalities used in checkout experiences across more than 100 countries and multiple frameworks. I helped integrate the Address Verification Service and contributed to building an async state machine that handled different verification outcomes. I also developed metadata‑driven form features powered by backend configuration, helped with the creation of region‑specific templates for Japan and China, and collaborated with C# services through REST APIs to support UI workflows. Along the way, I used spec‑driven development with Windsurf to create thorough specification and planning artifacts, and wrote thorough unit tests covering lifecycle, state transitions, validation, and public API functionality.

positions.title: Information Technology (IT)
positions.description: In this role, I supported customers and facility staff by diagnosing and resolving software issues across a variety of devices. I remotely accessed handheld equipment through a Virtual Cloud Network to repair malfunctioning software and personally fixed more than 30 parking devices by identifying errors and applying the correct code solutions. I also served as a general troubleshooting resource for all personnel, ensuring their systems stayed functional and reliable.

positions.title: Bioinformatics Research Lab
positions.description: Improved RNA genome analysis workflows by converting older Python code into more efficient C++ implementations. I spent significant time studying scholarly articles and existing codebases to build the background knowledge needed for the project. I worked both in the lab and remotely for about ten hours each week, contributing steadily to the team’s research efforts.
